title: Deluxe Fan Book: Yoroiden Samurai Troopers
originalTitle: 愛蔵本 鎧伝サムライトルーパー
summary: A packed magazine supplement with profiles, character introductions, episode digests, notes on the armors and Inferno Armor, a YES/NO game, and an original story explaining the notorious repeated broadcast as the work of the Netherworld. The source reviewer calls it their first Troopers book and especially valuable because it appeared while the TV series was still airing.
